site_ui.lead: Build a digital product around a specific buyer and problem, then connect product creation, storefront setup, distribution, and follow-on offers while tracking customer outcomes and sales economics.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters of Digital Product Empire synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies with timestamped inline attribution. The accounts connect AI-assisted products and Notion templates with storefront economics, payment choices, upsells, paid funnels, communities, launch models, newsletters, and faceless content, examining both demonstrated workflows and operational bottlenecks.

flow: Research a specific buyer and painful problem, then define the offer before choosing the product format.
Create a focused PDF, ebook, app, or Notion template; edit AI output and inspect the pages, formulas, and functions before sale.
Publish the product listing, make access instructions clear, connect payments, and test the app purchase flow with a real credit card.
Start audience-building during creation, connect a small-win freebie to the paid offer, and use organic content to test demand before paid promotion.
Use email follow-up and relevant courses, memberships, or coaching to extend the entry product without switching to a different customer.
Separate weak views, visits, and purchases when diagnosing sales; improve listings and support instructions while tracking actual customer outcomes.
